steps.code:
# Determine current month boundaries and fetch all received transactions this month.
from datetime import datetime

access_token = login_response["access_token"]
today = datetime.now()
start_of_month = today.replace(day=1, hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
# Use a far-future end date to include all transactions up to now.
end_of_month = today.replace(year=3000, month=1, day=1)

min_created_at = start_of_month.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
max_created_at = end_of_month.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")

print("min:", min_created_at, "max:", max_created_at)

page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
received_transactions = []

while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_transactions(
        access_token=access_token,
        direction="received",
        min_created_at=min_created_at,
        max_created_at=max_created_at,
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=page_limit,
    )
    if not page:
        break
    received_transactions.extend(page)
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

print("count:", len(received_transactions))
print(received_transactions)
